    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    CashierPanel
    Cashier screen: a grid of drink buttons plus a pop-up overlay for choosing size, sugar level, ice level and one topping, with a live price total.
    CashierPanel.CartItem
    One drink in the cart, stored as the raw choices needed to save it to the database.
    CashierPanel.MenuItem
    One row of the menu_items table: the drink's id, display name and Medium price.
    CashierPanel.OptionButton
    A rounded toggle button that paints its own background, so the selected colour looks the same on every look and feel (Windows, macOS, Linux).
    CashierPanel.OutOfStockException
    Thrown when an order needs more of an ingredient than the inventory has left.
    dbSetup
    Database connection settings for the POS system.
    LoginPanel
    A Swing panel that prompts employees for a PIN and authenticates them against the employee database.
    Main
    Entry point for the POS application.
    MainFrame
    The application window.
    ManagerPanel
    Manager screen: tabs for viewing and editing the menu, inventory, employees and toppings, plus read-only reports (popular drinks, recent orders, an hourly order graph and the X-report).
    ManagerPanel.HourlyGraphCanvas
    A simple bar chart of order counts for each hour of one day.
    ManagerPanel.NamedId
    An id and name pair shown in a drop-down as "id - name".
